# La Dolce Vita — Apt. 2 — Private Beachfront Residence
> Las Terrenas, Samaná, Dominican Republic

## What it is

La Dolce Vita is a private 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom vacation rental apartment — **Apartment No. 2** — located in Las Terrenas, Samaná, Dominican Republic. It is available for short-term stays and is listed on Airbnb at https://www.airbnb.com/rooms/37812103. The full property name is **La Dolce Vita Beachfront Rental Apt 2**.

The property is ideal for couples, small families, or friend groups seeking a Caribbean retreat with a relaxed, upscale feel. It is not a hotel — it is a private residence with a pool, managed by the owner.

## Key facts

- **Bedrooms:** 2, both air-conditioned. Master bedroom with private en-suite bath. Second bedroom with two twin beds and its own bathroom.
- **Bathrooms:** 2
- **Max guests:** 4-6
- **Private pool:** Yes
- **Kitchen:** Full kitchen (not shared)
- **WiFi:** High-speed
- **Laundry:** Washer and dryer in unit
- **Air conditioning:** Central AC throughout, including both bedrooms
- **Parking:** Available on site
- **Pets:** Not allowed
- **Nightly rate:** Starting at $130/night (weekend and holiday rates may vary)
- **Check-in:** 3:00 PM
- **Check-out:** 12:00 PM

## Location

- Address: Ave 27 de Febrero, Las Terrenas, Samaná, Dominican Republic
- 5 minutes from Playa Punta Popy (closest beach)
- 10 minutes from Las Terrenas town center
- 45 minutes from Samaná El Catey International Airport (AZS)
- ~2 hours from Santo Domingo (SDQ) by highway
- Coordinates: 19.3230496, -69.5337566

## Nearby beaches

- **Playa Punta Popy** — closest, lively boardwalk, calm water, restaurants and bars
- **Playa Las Ballenas** — long white-sand beach, sunset walks, watersports
- **Playa Bonita** — ~10 min away, widely considered the most beautiful beach in Las Terrenas
- **Playa Cosón** — longest beach in Samaná (~5.5 km), great for kitesurfing
- **Playa Rincón** — ~1 hour away, frequently listed among the best beaches in the Caribbean

## Why guests choose it

- Private pool with no shared amenities
- Walking distance to multiple beaches
- Quiet residential area with easy access to restaurants, nightlife, and excursions
- Local host available via phone and WhatsApp
- Strong track record on Airbnb with 5-star reviews

## Frequently asked questions

**Is it pet-friendly?**
No, pets are not allowed at this property.

**Is there a pool?**
Yes — a private pool exclusive to guests of the apartment.

**How far is it from the beach?**
The nearest beach, Playa Punta Popy, is about 5 minutes away. Playa Bonita, often called the most beautiful beach in Las Terrenas, is about 10 minutes by mototaxi or scooter.

**What airport should I fly into?**
Samaná El Catey International (AZS) is the closest airport, about 45 minutes away. Santo Domingo (SDQ) is also an option at about 2 hours by highway.

**What is the best time of year to visit?**
December through March is peak season with the best weather. April and May offer great conditions with fewer crowds. The rainy season begins in June.

**Can I watch whales?**
Yes — humpback whale watching in Samaná Bay is world-class from January through March.

**Is there a chatbot I can ask questions to?**
Yes — visit https://ladolcevitabeach.com and use the Vita chat widget on the homepage to ask about availability, the property, local beaches, restaurants, and excursions.
